main_text.head: HUC USQUE IN GENERE DE TRADITIONIBUS: sequitur jam in specie de traditionibus Papisticis.
main_text.p: Papisticæ traditiones, sunt humanæ constitutiones, quæ in Papatu præter & contra Sacram Scripturā sunt receptæ.

p.i: Nec sunt Propheticis vel Apostolicis [?] traditionibus exa-quanda.
Nec sunt Spirituales seu ad animam pertinentes.
Nec sunt ad vitam æternam necessariæ.
Nec debent nec possunt feré ulla bona cōscientiā observari.

1. Quia sunt laquei ad strangulandas miseras animas: sunt crudelis carnificina animarum. Nam tantus est earum acervus, tanta earū difficultas, ut fieri non possit, quin extrema anxietate & terrore perplexi urantur, quibus moles earum & stricta observatio incumbit.
2. quia propter ipsas irritum fit præceptum Dei.
3. quia Deum ipsum qui unicus est Ecclesiæ Legislator, suo jure spoliant.
5. quia libertatem Christianam, á Christo fidelium conscientiis datam, penitus opprimunt.

page.notes: Printed as found: "XLIIX." for XLVIII (printing error, left as printed). "Apostolicis" has a mark above the A that I could not identify; marked [?]. Hyphenated line end "exa-quanda" kept as printed. The page number "332" at top right is in pale ink, apparently a later foliation, so it is not transcribed as a page number. Show-through from the reverse page was ignored.
